text:
jamie: Quick plan: we want to unpin runtime-3.9 in eu-central-1 tomorrow 05:00 UTC. The perf regression was fixed in 3.9.2 but we need a phased rollout because quant-v2 workloads still show tokenization deltas when SDK >=4.0.0.

deploybot: (bot) Change window scheduled: unpin-window-4800 at 2026-03-25T05:00Z. Use `/deploybot unpin` to start.

sasha: Context: regression was due to kernel fallback ordering; 3.9.2 swaps selection and adds a guard. Verified on canary nodes. Risk: SDK tokenization change surfaces different prompt pre-tokenization for long prompts (>4k tokens).

arun: Proposed rollout: eu-central-1 only. Steps:
- Step 0: create canary subset (10% traffic) routed to runtime-3.9.2
- Step 1: monitor for 30m for output-diff rate and p99 latency
- Step 2: 50% for 20m, then 100% if green
- Fail path: revert routing and pin back to 3.8.6; open immediate rollback PR.

maya: Ops ready. I will apply staging routing rule r-euc-780 and add sticky pin exception for verified customers. Need release-note blurb for breaking SDK change.

taylor: Support note: we'll proactively message enterprise customers with heavy embed/longseq usage. @nina can you draft an advisory? Also prepare a rollback support playbook.

nina: Drafted advisory: "Runtime 3.9.2 rollout in eu-central-1. SDK v4.0.0+ changes tokenization behavior causing minor output diffs for very long prompts. Recommended: pin SDK to 3.9.x for deterministic output until runtime 3.9.2+compat patch lands." Will share doc link when ready.

jamie: Important: mark SDK v4.0.0 as "runtime-3.9: partial incompatibility" in release notes. Add automated smoke evals comparing outputs (token-level hash) as gate.

sasha: Smoke eval command (example):
```
python infra/eval/smoke_compare.py --from=3.8.6 --to=3.9.2 --suite=longseq --threshold=0.02
```
We consider >0.02 divergence as fail.

deploybot: (bot) Command executed: `/deploybot unpin runtime=3.9 region=eu-central-1 actor=jamie window=unpin-window-4800` - queued.

maya: Canary started: routing r-euc-780 -> runtime-3.9.2 at 10% traffic. Warmup note: traffic will ramp if smoke evals show <0.02 divergence and no customer alerts.

arun: Observability update (35m): smoke eval divergence 0.007, p99 latency +2% (within expected). No error spikes. Proceeding to 50%.

taylor: Support watching dashboards + #support-enterprise. If any customer reports unexpectedly different completions, escalate to eng-ml and include eval hashes.

jamie: Reminder: SDK compatibility matrix update needed. I'll open a tiny PR to mark v4.0.0 as flagged for longseq with runtime 3.9 until compat shim is backported.

sasha: We'll prepare runtime-3.9.3 with a tokenization shim + deterministic seed to fully close the gap. ETA: 48h. Until then we'll keep the phased rollout and an escape hatch to pin back.

maya: 100% rollout completed at 06:40 UTC after green checks. Notifying customers and updating release notes.

nina: Advisory posted to customers + release notes updated. Added recommended SDK pin command: `pip install redwood-sdk==3.9.12` in the advisory.

jamie: Closing notes: leave an audit entry with routing IDs and unpin window ID. If we see any regression, rollback plan is: `/deploybot pin runtime=3.8.6 region=eu-central-1 reason="regression" actor=<engineer>` and open rollback ticket. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: (bot) Change window unpin-window-4800 closed. Audit ID audit-4800-ux."
